wu: Human Bingo: Students mingle asking 'What's your name? How old are you? Where do you live?' to fill bingo cards with classmates' details.
wuAlt: Alphabet Chain: Students stand in a circle and say 'A is for apple, B is for banana...' taking turns.
Number Race: Teacher calls out numbers 0-20, students write them on mini-boards.
pres: Show a sample registration form on the board; model filling it with your details ('My name is... I am... years old. I live at...'); drill pronunciation of 'name', 'age', 'address'.
presAlt: Realia props: Hold up an ID card, ask 'What's this? It's my ID. My name is...'; students repeat.
Dialogue: Roleplay a registration scene with a student ('Hello, what's your name? My name is...').
prac: Form-filling pairs: Students get blank forms, take turns asking and writing partner's details; teacher circulates to correct spelling and pronunciation.
pracAlt: Spelling Bee: Teacher says a name/city (e.g., 'Oujda'), students spell it aloud; fastest wins a point.
Number Dictation Race: Dictate ages (e.g., 'twenty-five'), students write numbers on paper; first pair correct wins.
ls: Listen and fill: Play a dialogue where two people exchange personal details; students listen and complete a half-filled form with missing letters/numbers.
re: Alphabet Jump: Teacher calls out a letter (e.g., 'G'), students jump and say a word starting with it; repeat with numbers (e.g., '15' = 'Fifteen!').
prod: Registration Roleplay: Students pretend to register at the American Space Oujda; one asks 'What's your name? How old are you? Where do you live?', the other answers and fills a form.
rw: Read and Match: Students read short form fields ('Name: __', 'Age: __') and match them to answers ('Fatima', '25') from a list; then copy the completed form.
st: Close with a song: 'Hello, Hello, What's Your Name?' (to the tune of 'Twinkle Twinkle') + recap: 'Today we learned to give and spell personal information. Thank you, class!'
g: Teams race to write the alphabet on the board, one letter per student.
Teacher calls numbers, students cross them off cards; first to shout 'Bingo!' wins.
Students spell names in a line; one mistake and they sit down.
Students guess teacher's age by asking 'Are you 20? 25? 30?' until correct.
diff: Fast finishers: Write a short paragraph introducing themselves (e.g., 'My name is... I am... I live at...').
Support: Use a word bank with alphabet letters and numbers 0-20 for spelling practice.
hw: Complete the sample registration form from class (write name, age, address).
Interview a family member: Ask their name, age, address and write it down.
Write 5 names and 5 ages in English (e.g., 'Layla: 22', 'Omar: 30').
tip: Use Moroccan names and addresses (e.g., 'Oujda, Morocco') to make the task relevant; praise effort over accuracy to build confidence.
